article.title: Imran's hospital transfer: SC turns down Uzma's application seeking early hearing of contempt plea
article.summary: ISLAMABAD: The Supreme Court on Monday turned down yet another request by Dr Uzma Khan, the sister of incarcerated PTI founder Imran Khan, for swift contempt of court proceedings against government functionaries for violating theAugust 18 orderdirection Imran’s transfer to a private hospital.The contempt of court petition has already beenfixedbefore a three-judge SC bench, consisting of Justice Shahid Waheed, Justice Naeem Akhtar Afghan and Justice Ishtiaq Ibrahim, for September 16.The same bench will resume hearing pending cases concerning the ex-premier’s health and family meetings on September 16. article.title: SC rejects early hearing plea in Imran hospital case
article.summary: The Supreme Court has once again rejected a request seeking an early hearing of a contempt of court petition filed by Imran Khan’s sister, Uzma Khan, over the transfer of the PTI founder to a hospital.
